title: DLA event (Contract 1, schema_version 1)
description: One recorded event, from the browser extension or the Windows agent. Human-readable version: event-schema.md. JSON Schema cannot check that duration_seconds equals end minus start, or that end is not before start, or that the host of url matches domain: the code that writes events must guarantee all three.

id.description: Unique id. A UUID is recommended.

duration_seconds.description: end minus start, in whole seconds.

app.description: Process name for agent events. null for extension events and idle events.

domain.description: Website domain only, lowercase, no scheme, path, query or port. null unless the event came from the extension.

url.description: Sanitized URL, extension events only (null otherwise): scheme, domain and path, nothing else. The query string and the fragment are always removed. Long random-looking path segments and known sensitive patterns (reset or login tokens, session ids, email or account ids) are replaced with *. The extension does this cleaning before anything is sent on. Stored only on the PC and never synced. The two 'not' checks below are a last-line safety net, not the cleaning itself.

anyOf.description: A path segment of 32 or more id-like characters is not allowed: it must have been replaced with *.
An email address is not allowed anywhere in the path.

title.description: Window or tab title, only when permitted. null (or masked) otherwise.

category.description: Label from the on-device AI. null until labelled.

uncertain.description: true when low confidence made the label fall back to Other.

allOf.description: Extension events: no app, a domain, never idle.
Agent events never have a domain or a url.
Agent events that are not idle have an app (process name).
Not labelled yet: no confidence, no label source, not uncertain.
A model label always has a confidence.
Uncertain means the model was unsure and the label fell back to Other.

utcTime.description: ISO 8601 in UTC with a trailing Z, whole seconds, for example 2026-10-27T05:15:00Z.
